# Codex 0.169.0 model picker

Captured on macOS on 2026-11-17 in a private `CODEX_HOME`, with no model turn.
Screens retain only the native dialog and remove trailing blank cells.

`top`, `middle`, and `bottom` show an eight-row window over ten models. The
standalone arrows indicate hidden rows without counting them; model numbers
remain absolute. The displayed `GPT-6.1 Terra` maps to the canonical model
slug `gpt-6.1-terra`.

The probe walked with arrows and cancelled with Escape, leaving the current
model and effort unchanged.
